verdict.rationale: Bento documents broad programmatic coverage: subscribers (bulk create/update, filtering), events, broadcasts (create and schedule), transactional email, chat triage, and data deletion APIs, plus an API reference browser. Its CLI claims 50+ commands for managing the "entire" account (sequences, templates, tags, fields), and an official MCP server sits on top. However, nothing shows UI-only surfaces such as visual workflows, segment building, forms, or site/team transfer being available via API, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API evidence for workflows, segments and forms, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
